responsibility: This file provides generic RTL-inspection utilities in the nds32 namespace that other backend modules, especially pipeline support, use to reason about instructions. It extracts PARALLEL elements, memory/base/offset operands, shift and branch suboperands, movd44 and divmod characteristics, and classifies load/store forms including single, double, post-update, and offset-register variants, making it a shared semantic decoding layer for NDS32 RTL patterns.
